name: Ottoman Cascade
summary: A central dome descends through two half-domes into a broad prayer hall, framed by slim minarets.
why: The stepped roofline draws on the massing of Ottoman mosque architecture. A wide, symmetric foundation balances the ascending central dome, while the deep open entrance gives the silhouette a clear place to enter.
risk: The half-domes simplify into a stepped building at 24 pixels. This is an invented architectural interpretation, not a representation of a particular mosque.
sub1: A calm rhythm of rising domes
reasonToChoose: A broad and dignified mosque silhouette should carry the identity.
